error: policy learning rate is outside the authorized adaptive range
cause: After an accepted update, the PPO runtime rearmed the just-completed update's starting LR. When the prospective warmup state selected a different next-update range, the generic same-configuration reset validator rejected the old rearmed LR before setting the new authorized LR.
correction: The cross-update warmup installer now verifies critic LR, changes only the policy-group LR to the already-authorized next starting value, and leaves all parameter-owned Adam state untouched. The production per-update reset validator remains unchanged and still enforces the active update's range.
